[SWS_UCM_00158] Cleanup of interrupted actions
⌈
After uncontrolled re-
set UCM shall perform cleanup and return the system into consistent state, from where
the client can continue in a controlled manner.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00158] Cleanup of interrupted actions
⌈
After an uncontrolled reset,
UCM shall check non volatile memory integrity, recover processed artifacts in case it
is corrupted and resume interrupted actions in order to return the system into a state
from where UCM can continue serving its Clients.
⌋
